summary: Rich Sorro Commons is a 100-unit affordable housing building at 150 Berry St in Mission Bay, developed by Mission Housing Development Corporation for families and people living with HIV/AIDS. Mission Housing's own project page states it opened in July 2002, the first affordable family housing development in Mission Bay.

milestones.text: Rich Sorro Commons opened -- the first affordable family housing development in Mission Bay.

sources.title: Assessor Historical Secured Property Tax Rolls (blklot 8706264, 150 Berry St): year_property_built 2003

open_questions: DataSF Assessor's own year_property_built field records 2003, one year after Mission Housing's stated July 2002 opening -- likely reflects the tax roll's assessment lag rather than a different construction date; not further reconciled here.
